objects.name: Why AI Projects Stall and How CIOs Can Respond
objects.description: Microsoft Threat Intelligence analyzed a cryptocurrency clipper campaign that combines clipboard theft, wallet replacement, Tor-based communications, and worm-like propagation. Beyond stealing cryptocurrency transactions, the malware establishes persistent access and enables follow-on activity through a lightweight backdoor capability. The post Crypto Clipper uses Tor and worm-like propagation for persistence and control appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog .
